description: This file defines the interface for a JSON writer library in C, providing functions to construct JSON objects and arrays with various data types, managing nested structures, and outputting JSON strings.

methods.name: jw_init
methods.description: Initializes a json_writer instance, setting up internal buffers.

methods.name: jw_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a json_writer instance.

methods.name: jw_object_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON object as the top-level structure, with optional pretty printing.

methods.name: jw_array_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON array as the top-level structure, with optional pretty printing.

methods.name: jw_object_string
methods.description: Adds a string key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_intmax
methods.description: Adds an integer (intmax_t) key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_double
methods.description: Adds a double-precision floating-point key-value pair to the current JSON object with specified precision.

methods.name: jw_object_true
methods.description: Adds a boolean true key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_false
methods.description: Adds a boolean false key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_null
methods.description: Adds a null key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_sub_jw
methods.description: Embeds a nested JSON writer structure as a value in the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts a nested JSON object inline as the value of a key.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts a nested JSON array inline as the value of a key.

methods.name: jw_array_string
methods.description: Adds a string value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_intmax
methods.description: Adds an integer (intmax_t) value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_double
methods.description: Adds a double value to the current JSON array with specified precision.

methods.name: jw_array_true
methods.description: Adds a boolean true value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_false
methods.description: Adds a boolean false value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_null
methods.description: Adds a null value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_sub_jw
methods.description: Embeds a nested JSON writer structure as a value in the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_argc_argv
methods.description: Appends multiple strings from argc/argv to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_argv
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated array of strings to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts an inline JSON object within the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts an inline JSON array within the current array.

methods.name: jw_is_terminated
methods.description: Checks if the current JSON structure is fully closed.

methods.name: jw_end
methods.description: Ends the current JSON object or array, closing it properly.
